incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming p99 tail spike in prod (us-west) detected ~1720050000. Auto-paging oncall.
Alice (oncall): I see p95 steady (~200ms) but p99 jumped to ~1.7s in the last 12 minutes. Several customers reported dropped websockets. Kicking off triage.
Ben (serving): Noted. We started a shadow roll of the int8-compact profile for streaming-v2 around 1720049600 (10% traffic) for perf testing. Could be correlated.
Carla (ml-infra): telemetry shows an uptick in small memcpy GPU ops and elevated dequant stall counts on long-session traces. The timing overlaps the shadow window.
Dave (sre): any customer incidents filed?
Eve (support): AcmePayments and BetaChat both posted issues — timeouts on realtime hooks and increased retry rates. AE has flagged a P1.
Alice (oncall): Immediate plan: 1) Cancel the shadow roll 2) Force routing to fp16 fallback for streaming-v2 3) Drain nodes that served int8-warmed sessions 4) Inform customers. Ben, can you cancel the rollout?
Ben (serving): Executing: `redwoodctl rollout cancel --name=shadow-int8-2026-04-06 --yes`
Ben (serving): Cancel confirmed. Routing should revert for newly started sessions.
Carla (ml-infra): Cancel propagated but a subset of infer-pods still show int8-warm state; their KV layouts are incompatible with the fp16 dequant path and are producing extra host<->gpu memcpy bursts.
Dave (sre): We'll cordon and drain the pods labeled `precision=shadow-int8` in us-west-2a/b. Starting now; ~3 mins to cycle each pod.
Ben (serving): Drains queued for 5 pods. Also increased the fallback percentage to fp16: `policy set-fallback --model=streaming-v2 --variant=fp16 --weight=0.95`.
Alice (oncall): Good. Metrics: pre-incident p95 ~200ms -> now 260ms; p99 peaked at 1.7s -> after mitigations down to ~480ms. Keep watching.
Carla (ml-infra): Root cause hypothesis: calibration path rewrote KV block layout (kv_schema_v3) and added a copy step for mid-sequence refreshes. That copy pattern fragments batching and causes many small kernel launches.
Ben (serving): We also see edge-router->infer RPC rate increase and batch size reduction; batching efficiency lost ~20% for 1k+ token sessions.
Eve (support): Customer message going out: "We're investigating elevated streaming latency in US-West. Mitigations deployed; we'll follow up with a full postmortem." Sending now.
Alice (oncall): Temporary mitigations summary: canceled shadow, forced fp16 fallback, drained affected pods, throttled new streaming session creation (to protect p99), and alerted customers. Add any missing steps.
Carla (ml-infra): Added telemetry tag `experiment:shadow-int8-2026-04-06` on all related traces. Also added filter for `gpu_memcpy_short_ops` for triage.
Dave (sre): For follow-up: collect `gpu_memcpy_q_len`, `kv_rewrite_durations_ms`, `router_batch_size`, `session_disconnect_rate` for window 1720049400-1720053600.
Ben (serving): Created an alert: if p99_streaming_us_west > 0.8s for 4m then `scale-dedicated` + `circuit-break-new-sessions`. Command: `alerts create --expr 'p99_streaming_us_west > 0.8' --for=4m --act='scale-dedicated,breaker'`.
Carla (ml-infra): Proposed fix: remove the extra memcpy by performing in-place dequant for prefix entries and add a migration that rewrites warmed KV nodes to the new layout without triggering the copy. Patch candidate owned by me.
Dave (sre): Opening incident ticket INC-2026-0461 and linking to runbook.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0461 created; severity P1 -> P2 after mitigations.
Alice (oncall): Handoff notes for night: current state p99 ~480ms and trending down. Customer acked recovery. Next actions for night team: validate backfill tool, run long-context perf replay in staging, and prepare canary of the patch (1% traffic). I'll hand off to Frank in 35m.
Ben (serving): We've disabled automatic shadow rollouts until the calibration pipeline has perf checks. Added a CI perf job for quant changes covering 2k token sessions.
Carla (ml-infra): ETA for patch + staging validation: 24-36 hours. If green, we'll canary at 1% for 6 hours with enhanced tracing.
Eve (support): Batch-update sent to affected accounts. AcmePayments confirmed improved metrics after the revert.
Alice (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving bridge open until handoff. Frank, you'll take the bridge and monitor alerts.
Frank (night-oncall): ack — joining early. Will run the checklist and keep Ops loop updated.
